delay_seconds.description: Back-off delay in seconds. Can be a single value or comma-separated list like '1,2,4,8'.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. 0 means unlimited.

notification_message.description: Custom message to display during backoff. Empty string uses default.

until_criteria.description: The criteria to stop retrying. Options: success, true, fail, false, or integer/range.

while_criteria.description: The criteria to keep retrying. Options: success, true, fail, false, or integer/range. Empty string disables this option.
